summary: This Phase 2 study tests how a plant-based capsule called Nigella Sativa affects blood fats in people taking atorvastatin for high cholesterol and fat levels. The trial plans to enroll 84 participants to take either the study capsule or a look-alike inactive placebo for eight weeks. Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujib Medical University, Dhaka, Bangladesh is sponsoring the research.
